create.title: Complete collar-extracted top-M2 actual-symbol normal form and odd-lift variation
create.statement_tex: Let J=sqrt X and 1<=L<=H<=J^(1/2). For the accepted exact normalized top symbol with fixed smooth eta_L and W, accepted C1 Phi, exact q_X, floors, stars, and finite odd support, remove one fixed smooth physical collar at each m-endpoint. Interpret pre-collar finite Poisson symmetrically. For h=ga, s=gb with primitive odd a<b<4a, delta=sqrt(b)-sqrt(a), Lambda=X delta^2/2, and J delta/(2 sqrt(a))<k<J delta/sqrt(b), retain the complete centred integral B^circ_(a,b,k)(g)=g int_(b/4)^a A^circ_(ga,gb)(gu)e(g[-J delta sqrt(u)+ku+X delta^2/(4k)])du. Then the exact positive-offset energy satisfies O_L=2 Re sum_(a,b,k)e(alpha) sum_(g=2n+1 in G_(a,b)) B^circ_(a,b,k)(g)e(-n Lambda/k)+O_(M,eta,Phi,W)(L^2 log(2+L)), where alpha=(b-a)/4-X delta^2/(4k). The error owns both full lattice endpoint samples, both removed collars, zero and positive modes, equality modes, and all negative nonstationary modes; retained stationary and transition modes have no expansion error. Uniformly through saddle entry and exit, |B^circ(g)|+g|d_g B^circ(g)| << J delta sqrt(G)/k^(3/2), G asymp L/b, hence its step-two endpoint-plus-total-variation has the same bound. The proof uses the exact factorization A_(ga,gb)(gu)=g^(-3)E_(a,b)(g)P_(a,b)(u), with P independent of g and E'(g)<<G^(-1), and the exact centred square. It is false for arbitrary bounded lift coefficients and proves no resonance-union or energy estimate.

reject.reason: With nonzero finite-interval endpoint values, the Poisson integral series requires symmetric or distributional summation. Absolute convergence holds only after the fixed collars make the amplitude smoothly compactly supported.

Arbitrary alternating or phase-conjugating lift coefficients can make the step-two variation comparable to the sum of pointwise masses. The theorem depends on the exact g-homogeneous factorization, slow eta/Phi factor, and g-independent W-ratio profile.

A frozen leading stationary value does not control saddle entry, exit, lower corrections, or moving collars. The valid proof retains the complete centred integral and differentiates it through the exact quadratic identity.
